ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: in the schematic diagram, there are numbered water-cycle links such as ①②③④. ③ is marked on the right side of the figure near the river channel, corresponding to the runoff link in which water flows and converges toward the river channel; it is not the precipitation or evaporation link at the top of the figure, nor is it the groundwater storage link. Reasoning: the Sanjiang Plain changing from "Great Northern Wilderness" to "Great Northern Granary" in the question means that a large amount of wetland was reclaimed into farmland. Wetlands originally have the functions of storing water, regulating floods, cutting peaks and supplementing lows; after wetlands are reclaimed, this ability to regulate runoff weakens, and the seasonal variation of river runoff or surface runoff will increase. The number in the figure that indicates this runoff-convergence link is ③.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：读出图中③对应右侧向河道汇流的径流环节，而不是上方的降水或蒸发，也不是地下水储存。再读题干：三江平原由“北大荒”变为“北大仓”指湿地被大量开垦为农田。结合湿地调节径流的知识，开垦削弱湿地蓄水调洪能力，使河流/地表径流的季节变化变大。把该环节对应回图中编号，得到③。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：示意图中有①②③④等编号水循环环节。③标在图右侧靠近河道的位置，对应水流向河道汇流的径流环节；它不是图上方的降水或蒸发环节，也不是地下水储存环节。
推理：题干中的三江平原由“北大荒”变为“北大仓”，表示大量湿地被开垦为农田。湿地原本具有蓄水、调洪、削峰补枯的作用；湿地被开垦后，这种调节径流的能力减弱，河流或地表径流的季节变化会增大。图中表示该径流汇流环节的编号是③。
